scientific_integrity: Finite enumerations and finite-model checks supplement but do not replace the unrestricted induction and separating-functional proof; no independent review or verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns a fixed finite propositional vocabulary, affine Boolean connectives, arbitrary one-relation frames, and finite modal depth; it does not assert unbounded-depth equivalence or a bisimulation invariant for other Boolean bases. The 192 count is an exact finite computation independently cross-checked by two enumerations. Residual priority risk from unindexed literature remains.
title: Affine successor-hull equivalence and the exact depth-two spectrum of the one-variable modal parity fragment
